levels.surface: أبو موسى، إسحاق بن موسى الأنصاري

notes: «أبو موسى، إسحاق بن موسى الأنصاري» is one man written as kunya, comma and name (rule 7)
«هو ابن عيسى» is an editor's gloss on معن, left out; Hafsa and Aisha's exchange and the Prophet's words are the story: Aisha is the last named link, and Hafsa is in the scene only
